children: will invest more than 10 billion euros  ($11 billion) in France over the coming years in electric vehicles and more affordable cars, its chief executive officer said on Saturday.
In an interview with France Inter radio, Francois Provost, said the group expects production in France to rise by more than 25% in 2026 thanks to the growth in electric vehicles.
